title: Michael Johnson vanishes with no records

tellings.quote: said yeah I agree with that that was the last time I ever saw him

plain: Mario Woods, a former US Air Force guard at the nuclear missile sites near Rapid City, South Dakota, says that in 1977 he and his partner, Michael Johnson, went through an encounter they could not explain. Speaking on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, Woods says that after it was over he never saw Johnson again, and that he could find no records of him. If true, it would suggest the Air Force separated the two men and kept the matter quiet.
